description: Front Desk is the day-to-day tool hotel teams use to run a shift: report and track maintenance tickets, read and leave shift notes for the next team, and log lost & found items — all from ChatGPT, with the same account and permissions you already have in Front Desk. Every action taken through ChatGPT shows up in Front Desk exactly as if you'd done it there, credited to your name.

defaultPrompt: Résume les consignes non lues du jour
